title: Validate Zephyr NMEA parser against L76K datasheet example output
description: Risk reduction: take the L76K datasheet's example NMEA output (or captured real output if available), create a host-level test that pipes it through Zephyr's gnss_nmea0183 parser, and verify lat/lon/alt/time/fix fields come out correct. Watch for: proprietary PMTK response sentences mixed in, multi-constellation talker IDs (GN vs GP), non-standard GSA/GSV field counts, interleaved multi-line GSV. ~30 minutes, no hardware needed, catches parser incompatibilities before bringup.
